resources.string: A pocket archive of the music you know by heart.
Browse albums and songs, and explore their stories.\nRead lyrics and discover the details.\nFollow tour dates and look forward to the next show.
A few things to know before you begin.
Jay Archive is an unofficial fan archive for release information, lyrics and concert schedules. Some features use the internet. Please read the details before continuing.
I have read and understood the usage and privacy information
Three styles, one archive. You can change these later in Settings.
Rounded surfaces and the familiar HyperOS feel
Start with an album. Rediscover Jay Chou.
Your appearance choices will be saved when you enter.\nBrowse the album catalog offline. Lyrics lookup, artwork and concert information use the internet.

Local data\nNo account is required. Appearance preferences, profile details, and imported images and lyrics are stored on your device. System backups may include app data. You can clear app data in system settings.

Online content\nOnline lyrics queries send song or artist information to VKeys. Concert details and images access sources such as JVR and Damai. Update checks connect to GitHub. These services can receive request contents and network information such as your IP address. Automatic update checks can be turned off in Settings.

About this archive\nThis app is not affiliated with Jay Chou or the relevant rights holders. It does not provide music playback, downloads or ticket transactions. Content belongs to its respective rights holders. Check official sources for the latest show times, seating and ticket details.
